stem: A Massachusetts sterile compounding pharmacy is replacing an ageing cleanroom air handling unit with an identical new one in the same position. Its director says a like-for-like swap changes nothing and needs no filing. Which statements are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: A like-for-like replacement falls outside the approval requirement.
Board approval is required before replacing any secondary engineering control.
Ordinary layout drawings suffice, since the configuration is unchanged.
The submission includes certified blueprints with ISO classification of each control.
Approval may be sought after the work if the pharmacy suspends compounding.

explanation.core_reasoning: 247 CMR 6.15(2) requires a sterile compounding pharmacy to apply for Board approval PRIOR TO MOVING, ADDING, MODIFYING, REMOVING OR REPLACING ANY SECONDARY ENGINEERING CONTROL and bars it from doing so until approval is received. Under 6.15(4) the submission includes CERTIFIED blueprints depicting compounding areas and the location and ISO CLASSIFICATION of each primary and secondary engineering control, a containment strategy, an environmental monitoring plan, a re-certification plan and a continuity of care plan, each as applicable.

choice_analysis.A: Replacing is one of the five verbs the regulation names.
choice_analysis.C: Certified blueprints with ISO classification are required.
choice_analysis.D: Correct: that is the first item on the list.
choice_analysis.E: The approval must precede the work.

related_facts: A re-certification plan and a continuity of care plan are included as applicable
explanation.mpje_trap: Candidates reason from whether the configuration changes rather than from whether a control is touched.

reasoning_steps: Test the proposed work against the five verbs the regulation names
Identify the heavier submission the compounding setting attracts
